description: Places a COMPLETE order (items + email + shipping address + optional shipping/parcel locker) and returns an ENCRYPTED, signed one-click link to /zamowienie-agenta. This tool does NOT create a cart or order and never pays — the customer clicks the link, sees LIVE prices and address, and pays THEMSELVES in our checkout. Orders above 500 PLN are not supported: the tool returns an error with a link to a regular cart. Without "dostawa" the tool returns the live shipping options, and the link is built with the cheapest one. Max 10 items.

paczkomat.description: InPost parcel locker code from the customer, e.g. WAW123M (optional).

wariant.description: Variant ID as returned in product details.
